content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

The architecture behind Bitcoin payments for digital downloads is built on a combination of free and paid tools that enable creators to host, deliver, and manage their digital products without relying on platform fees or restrictions. By using infrastructure like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, creators can maintain full control over their commerce stack and data, making it an attractive option for those who value infrastructure sovereignty.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is built for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, but are locked out of traditional payment platforms due to country or platform restrictions. By providing a sovereign alternative, creators can maintain control over their commerce stack and data, giving them the freedom to scale and grow their businesses without being held back by restrictive payment policies.
NOWPayments handles on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, eliminating the need for intermediaries and their associated fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this architecture work together include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component is carefully selected to provide a seamless and scalable solution for digital creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Next, they can follow a series of concrete deployment steps, including setting up GitHub Pages, configuring Cloudflare Workers, and integrating NOWPayments with their commerce stack. With these steps, creators can have a fully functional digital store up and running in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question to ask is: Can I sell digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms? The answer is yes, using a sovereign architecture built on tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. This approach not only eliminates platform fees but also provides creators with full control over their commerce stack and data.

If you're looking for a way to sell ebooks, templates, and fonts without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, this architecture is worth exploring. Additionally, the Complete Builder Kit provides the necessary tools to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, making it an attractive option for creators looking to expand their business without being held back by restrictive payment policies. You can purchase the Complete Builder Kit for $197, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build a sovereign digital commerce stack. For more information on how to get started, visit our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this architecture, follow these concrete steps: Start by setting up a GitHub Pages site to host your digital products. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers to automate delivery and manage orders. Then, integrate NOWPayments with your commerce stack to handle on-chain crypto payment verification. Finally, set up Supabase to store orders and Google Drive to deliver files. With these steps, you can have a fully functional digital store up and running in no time.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my commerce stack?

To integrate NOWPayments with your commerce stack, you'll need to provide your NOWPayments API key and configure the payment gateway in your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script code. This will enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and eliminate the need for intermediaries.
Can I use this architecture to sell physical products?

No, this architecture is specifically designed for digital products and does not support the sale of physical goods. If you need to sell physical products, you'll need to explore alternative solutions that integrate with traditional payment gateways.
How do I handle refunds and chargebacks using this architecture?

Refunds and chargebacks can be handled manually by creators using a combination of Supabase and Google Sheets to manage orders and NOWPayments to verify payments. However, this process can be complex and may require additional configuration and support.
Can I use this architecture to sell subscription-based products?

Yes, this architecture can be used to sell subscription-based products by integrating a recurring payment solution like NOWPayments and setting up automated delivery of digital content using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will enable creators to offer subscription-based products without relying on traditional payment platforms.
How do I scale this architecture to meet increasing demand?

To scale this architecture, creators can leverage the power of Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script to automate delivery and manage orders, as well as set up Supabase to store orders and Google Drive to deliver files. Additionally, NOWPayments can be configured to handle increased payment volume and provide a seamless payment experience for customers.
Can I customize this architecture to meet my specific needs?

Yes, this architecture is highly customizable and can be tailored to meet the specific needs of each creator. By leveraging the power of free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that meets their unique requirements and scales with their business.
